title: A Brønsted-based deep eutectic solvent as a green catalyst for the sustainable one-pot synthesis of 1,2,4,5-tetrasubstituted imidazole derivatives: in vitro cytotoxicity and in silico binding studies on HepG2 cells
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,15249-15265
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00422A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Tuan-Anh Ngoc Tran, Linh Dieu Nguyen, Khoi Nam Nguyen, Phu Hoang Dang, Hai Truong Nguyen
1,2,4,5-Tetrasubstituted imidazoles were synthesized via a green, one-pot reaction using [Bet]2[PTSA]. Structure-activity relationship analysis indicated that phenolic hydroxyl and para-methoxy substituents enhance anticancer activity.
